finding.claim: With noext:true the scanner clears isGlob for all patterns, so a pattern like *.js that still contains a star is incorrectly reported as non-glob.
finding.title: noext incorrectly clears isGlob

verifier.reason: The unconditional block at scan.js:301-304 sets isGlob=false whenever opts.noext is true, and that cleared value is reported in the returned state at scan.js:348, so a plain star pattern such as *.js loses its glob status.
